note: Real 5-star Google reviews of Dental Heights. Each entry points to its screenshot in src/assets/images/testimonials/ (shown as-is, never edited). `text` is a transcription of the review, used as the image description for screen readers.

reviews.name: Irene A.
reviews.text: Highly recommended! My new fave dental clinic, a place where your confidence starts. Thank you so much Doc Mign and the team for the excellent dental care.

reviews.name: Kidgun M.
reviews.text: One of the best dental clinics I've visited! From reception to treatment, everything was smooth and professional. Will definitely return and recommend to others. Thanks Dr. Jade.

reviews.name: Marnie S.
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Doc Stella is an expert in her field and is very professional. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Marvin B.
reviews.text: Their doctor works professionally and with passion. I loved their approach and services. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Rock G.
reviews.text: Friendly doctors and staff. Would recommend.
